typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsSplitStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CMNE as string,
		BR as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		ORIGDEALNO as string,
		ORIGSEQ as string,
		ORIGPRODUCT as string,
		ORIGPRODTYPE as string,
		ORIGVDATE as timestamp,
		ORIGPRODSYS as string,
		CNO as string,
		PAYRECIND as string,
		IOPER as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp,
		VERIND as string,
		VERDATE as timestamp,
		VEROPER as string,
		PAYRECOPER as string,
		SETTDATE as timestamp,
		CCY as string,
		SPLITAMT as decimal(19,4),
		CCYSMEANS as string,
		CCYSACCT as string,
		OFFSETSMEANS as string,
		OFFSETSACCOUNT as string,
		CCYRATE_8 as decimal(18,8),
		CCYBAMT as decimal(19,4),
		COST as string,
		SIIND as string,
		SWIFTMATCHIND as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		AUTHIND as string,
		AUTHOPER as string,
		AUTHDATE as timestamp,
		REVOPER as string,
		REVDATE as timestamp,
		REVREASON as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		DATE1 as timestamp,
		DATE2 as timestamp,
		AMT1 as decimal(19,4),
		AMT2 as decimal(19,4),
		RATE1_8 as decimal(18,8),
		RATE2_8 as decimal(18,8),
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp,
		EXCLUDEACCTNGIND as string,
		PROCESSIND as string,
		STATUS as string,
		LINKDEALNO1 as string,
		LINKDEALNO2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsPlusDB	source(output(
		origdealno as string,
		origvdate as timestamp,
		seq as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OpicsPlusDB derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp()))) ~> GetLoadDate
GetLoadDate,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OpicsPlusDB@ORIGDEALNO == LookupLKPTABLE@origdealno && OpicsPlusDB@ORIGVDATE == LookupLKPTABLE@origvdate && OpicsPlusDB@SEQ == LookupLKPTABLE@seq,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		ORIGPRODTYPE as string,
		CCYBAMT as integer,
		PROCESSIND as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ORIGPRODUCT as string,
		VERDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ORIGVDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		REVOPER as string,
		STATUS as string,
		AMT2 as integer,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCYSMEANS as string,
		AMT1 as integer,
		DATE2 as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SIIND as string,
		SWIFTMATCHIND as string,
		DATE1 as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RATE1_8 as integer,
		PAYRECIND as string,
		SETTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LINKDEALNO1 as string,
		LINKDEALNO2 as string,
		EXCLUDEACCTNGIND as string,
		CCYSACCT as string,
		OFFSETSACCOUNT as string,
		ORIGDEALNO as string,
		CMNE as string,
		SEQ as string,
		IOPER as string,
		SPLITAMT as integer,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		ORIGSEQ as string,
		CNO as string,
		REVREASON as string,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BR as string,
		REVTEXT as string,
		OFFSETSMEANS as string,
		COST as string,
		AUTHIND as string,
		PAYRECOPER as string,
		CCYRATE_8 as integer,
		DEALNO as string,
		SPOTFWDIND as string,
		AUTHDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RATE2_8 as integer,
		AUTHOPER as string,
		REVDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		VERIND as string,
		VEROPER as string,
		CCY as string,
		ORIGPRODSYS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		ORIGPRODTYPE,
		CCYBAMT,
		PROCESSIND,
		INPUTDATE,
		ORIGPRODUCT,
		VERDATE,
		ORIGVDATE,
		REVOPER,
		STATUS,
		AMT2,
		PRODUCT,
		CCYSMEANS,
		AMT1,
		DATE2,
		SIIND,
		SWIFTMATCHIND,
		DATE1,
		RATE1_8,
		PAYRECIND,
		SETTDATE,
		LINKDEALNO1,
		LINKDEALNO2,
		EXCLUDEACCTNGIND,
		CCYSACCT,
		OFFSETSACCOUNT,
		ORIGDEALNO,
		CMNE,
		SEQ,
		IOPER,
		SPLITAMT,
		PRODTYPE,
		ORIGSEQ,
		CNO,
		REVREASON,
		LSTMNTDATE,
		BR,
		REVTEXT,
		OFFSETSMEANS,
		COST,
		AUTHIND,
		PAYRECOPER,
		CCYRATE_8,
		DEALNO,
		SPOTFWDIND,
		AUTHDATE,
		RATE2_8,
		AUTHOPER,
		REVDATE,
		VERIND,
		VEROPER,
		CCY,
		ORIGPRODSYS),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsSplitStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsSplitStaging
